column1: # Ou, Eilers, Necib & Frebel 2024, MNRAS 528, 693 (arXiv:2303.12838), Table 1.
# Measurements of the circular velocity of the Milky Way.  Transcribed from the arXiv PDF text layer.
# VERIFIED 2026-09-03 against the paper's own LaTeX source (curl https://arxiv.org/e-print/2303.12838
#   -> tab01.tex): all 37 rows match exactly, so this transcription is authoritative.
# R0 = 8.178 kpc (GRAVITY Collab. 2019) assumed by the authors.  Errors below are RANDOM only;
# the authors' total SYSTEMATIC uncertainty is, in their own words (Sec. 3.2 of the source): 'The total
# systematic uncertainty ranges between 1 per cent to 5 per cent up to R = 22 kpc, increasing to 15 per
# cent' beyond, dominated there by the neglected asymmetric-drift term.  They also state that 'the
# systematic uncertainties are insufficient to explain the decline ... starting at R ~ 15 kpc'.
# Their baryonic model (their Table 2, also verified against the source) is Misiriotis+2006 double
# 7.00e7/5.00/0.10, warm dust 2.20e5/3.30/0.09 (Msun / Rd kpc / zd kpc) -- plus a de Salas+2019
